verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls handle CCPA data-sale opt-out and GDPR consent state, with forwarding rules such as 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'. That covers the suppression side of the story: opted-out users' data is withheld from destinations. The pack does not show that mParticle processes deletion (erasure) requests or forwards those requests to connected destinations, and the GDPR/CCPA compliance doc appears only as a title. missing for 10: documented user deletion/erasure request processing, propagation of deletion and suppression requests to downstream destinations, request status tracking, independent corroboration.
